lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, with clear 2D spacing between centroids on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice pattern primarily visible in the mid-flank region above the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges exhibit a light-to-shadow vertical gradient, running parallel across the upper flank from the branchial area toward the posterior.
